name: Clevis Grab Hook
desc:
The HGC Clevis Grab Hook is specifically engineered to be used with Grade 80 alloy lifting chains. Its narrow clevis opening ensures that only the correct chain size can be fitted, allowing full engagement between the hook and chain to prevent accidental slip-off during lifting operations.
Material: High-grade alloy steel, quenched and tempered
Chain Compatibility: Designed for use with Grade 80 alloy lifting chains
Marking: Batch number, size, CE marking, G80/T8, manufacturer identification, and product code embossed on the hook
Ultimate Load: 4 times the rated working load capacity
Proof Load: 2.5 times the Working Load Limit (WLL)
Fatigue Rating: 1.5 times the WLL for 20,000 load cycles
Design Feature: Narrow clevis opening allows only the correct chain size to be fitted
Safety Feature: Full engagement of the chain in the hook helps prevent slip-off during lifting
